posts.name: jorgenp
posts.cooked:
I notice you went out of your way to play them in the same turn, Dandolo, but that isn't part of it.  My plays were all Tempest's normal Play a Card Phase of his turn over three Rounds.

It's good you have a different order than me, going BL->LS->CL while I went the opposite order CL->LS->BL.  It shows that both Chain Lightning and Ball Lightning are required.  We just need someone else to test with the third card being Lightning Slash to confirm all three One-Shots are needed.

It seems the only thing we don't know is if all the Ongoings are needed, or just a subset.  Perhaps he doesn't need Otherworldly Resilience, as that one isn't actually controlling the weather, unlike the other Ongoings.  Cleansing Downpour and Shielding Winds are also defensive, so they might not be needed to be in play.  Anyone want to try without these cards?

OK, so I just tested this on my phone version which I grabbed in the recent sale and I don't really plan to buy the expansions...

I couldn't get it to unlock.  All 7 Ongoings in play, playing the three One-Shots did nothing.  I did try beforehand in the same fight with only 6 of the 7 Ongoings, but I doubt that would have messed anything up.

 

The only conclusion I can come to right now is that PW:AA being unlocked, or at least part of his unlock sequence being performed, is needed.

So I am revising my theory to it either being:

Unlock Prime Wardens Argent Adept.  Then, Tempest plays Lightning Slash, Ball Lightning and Chain Lightning in the same fight while he has all 7 of his Ongoing cards in play.

or

Lose to Akash'Bhuta with Tempest on the team.  Then, Tempest plays Lightning Slash, Ball Lightning and Chain Lightning while he has all 7 of his Ongoing cards in play.

I can't test my theories any further beyond that without purchasing packs on the mobile version.

posts.name: Kratos13
posts.cooked:
Unlock successful. 

I did my best to be meticulous and gradually tried the Ball Lightning, Chain Lightning and Lightning Slash combo after each round of playing ongoings (and rewound if no unlock):

Vicious Cyclone: no unlock

Vicious Cyclone, Localized Hurricane: no unlock

Vicious Cyclone, Localized Hurricane, Electrical Storm: no unlock

Vicuous Cyclone, Localized Hurricane, Electrical Storm, Grievous Hailstorm: unlock

Those were the only Ongoings played and no equipment was ever played. Never used any power other than Tempest's base power. Never discarded cards for Vicious Cyclone.  Never Reclaimed from the Deep.

So Vicious Cyclone, Localized Hurricane, Electrical Storm and Grievous Hailstorm could be the minimum ongoings required in play before playing Ball Lightning, Chain Lightning and Lightning Slash.  Has anyone unlocked without these four ongoings?

posts.name: jorgenp
posts.cooked:
Ok, so the guess earlier was correct!  All the offensive weather cards... Thank you very much for being so meticulous.

Let's formalise what we have it narrowed down to:

Unlock Prime Wardens Argent Adept.  Then, with Vicious Cyclone, Localized Hurricane, Electrical Storm and Grievous Hailstorm in play, play Lightning Slash, Ball Lightning and Chain Lightning in any order.

If anyone else wants to test, I think you should try to remove Vicious Cyclone and Electrical Storm from the list.  We know Grievous Hailstorm is necessary and it may just want the Power cards...  So have Grievous Hailstorm and Localized Hurricane in play and try to play the three One-Shots.  Then have Grievous Hailstorm, Localized Hurricane and Electrical Storm in play and try to play the One-Shots.  That's the most likely way to narrow down easier strats.

Then again, perhaps we already figured it out (crosses fingers).

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: I don't think it's a synergy piece it's just that often as Tempest you'll have large hands and no means of playing the cards.   You can lessen the blows with Elemental Subwave Inducer and Otherworldy Resilience.   Or a more unique way of getting less damage is having two Localized Hurricanes, Shielding Winds, and the ones I mentioned earlier which will also bring the damage down to one in a roundabout way.

posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked: There is some synergy, too. Energy Bracer, Counterpoint Bulwark, and sharing a Haka of Shielding are all direct mitigation, Augmented Ally and Dynamic Siphon let you indirectly mitigate by firing off a Cleansing Downpour, and Vitality Conduit is a more straightforward indirect mitigation. And Dynamic Siphon can make PW Tempest an emergency button if you have a Flash Flood or Ball Lightning in hand and need something gone really quick after his turn (like when you kill something in the environment and Akash decides to drop a dad-blasted Entomb into your lap as a result).

posts.name: seesome
posts.cooked: I love this variant and find PW Tempest to be way more useful than F6 Tempest.  If you start with good cards in your hand, you can take a hit early to get a bunch of stuff into play quickly.  If not, you ignore the base power until you can get out something to reduce the damage and then start playing a ton of cards each turn.  It's also great for dealing with targets that you want to do a lot of damage to all in one turn (gives a side-eye to Progeny).
